name: Daeva
baneSummary: After the second and later feeding from the same mortal, roll Humanity. Failure causes the Persistent Dependent Condition toward that mortal until the mortal dies.

name: Gangrel
baneSummary: Dice pools to resist frenzy are capped by Humanity. This does not affect riding the wave.

name: Mekhet
baneSummary: At Humanity 6 choose a personal Bane not tied to a breaking point. It counts toward the normal limit, and Humanity counts as one lower for Humanity-based banes, including sunlight and torpor.

name: Nosferatu
baneSummary: Against humans, Humanity counts as two lower for Social penalties and failed Presence or Manipulation rolls become dramatic failures. This does not apply to Touchstones or Kindred.

name: Ventrue
baneSummary: The first Touchstone is attached to Humanity 7. Further Touchstones may occupy Humanity 6 through 2.

name: Jiang Shi
baneSummary: Feeding cannot inflict the Swooned or Scarred Conditions. A Jiang Shi who does not spend daysleep at their grave must spend two Vitae instead of one to wake.
